newsitem.title: GERMANY: British helicopter crashes in Germany, no deaths.
newsitem.headline: British helicopter crashes in Germany, no deaths.

text.p: A British military helicopter crashed near the Bavarian village of Urspring on Saturday evening, injuring one crew member, the British Forces in Germany said.
The injured crew member was being treated in a German hospital. Two others and five passengers were taken to hospital for precautionary checks but were expected to be released soon.

The Royal Air Force Puma helicopter crashed at about 1900 gmt as it was coming in to land near the city of Murnau, the British Forces said. The helicopter is based at RAF Laarbruch in North-Rhine-Westphalia and had been supporting a RAF winter training exercise in the Murnau area.
